comment: Per-model capability manifest for the fal multiplexer. Every entry is documented-best-effort until a maintainer captures a real-API smoke trace for that model — verified:false entries MUST NOT be trusted for planning-critical decisions without surfacing the flag. Durations in seconds; cost_per_second_usd is a modeled estimate, never a quote.

fal-ai/kling-video/v2/master/text-to-vid.label: Kling v2 Master (text-to-video)
fal-ai/kling-video/v2/master/text-to-vid.input_notes: duration is an enum string '5'|'10'; aspect_ratio; negative_prompt supported; cfg_scale optional

fal-ai/wan/v2.2-a14b/text-to-video.label: Wan 2.2 A14B (text-to-video)
fal-ai/wan/v2.2-a14b/text-to-video.input_notes: resolution enum ('480p'|'580p'|'720p') instead of free aspect; num_frames-driven duration; seed supported

fal-ai/ltx-2/text-to-video.label: LTX-2 (text-to-video, synchronized audio)
fal-ai/ltx-2/text-to-video.input_notes: generates synchronized audio natively (audio_sync); resolution up to 4K; duration in seconds

fal-ai/veo3.label: Google Veo 3 (text-to-video, native audio)
fal-ai/veo3.input_notes: fixed 8s clips; dialogue/ambient rendered from the prompt text; aspect_ratio; generate_audio flag

fal-ai/hunyuan-video.label: Hunyuan Video (text-to-video)
fal-ai/hunyuan-video.input_notes: num_frames-driven duration; resolution enum; no negative_prompt
